subject: Runbook & sample exchange — POC hands-on scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Glover <alex.glover@finchai.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@finchai.com
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: POC hands-on session & sample payloads

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood last week. Were aiming to lock in a 2-hour hands-on session for the POC where we: run prompt routing checks, validate routing fallback, and run a short load test with ~50 concurrent users emulated. Can Laura or someone from the infra team own the runbook and accept sample payloads?

We have a small sample set (customer-support transcripts + search queries) but need guidance on redaction and a template for expected CSV/JSON. I can share a redacted export — would rather not dump PHI.

Proposed windows (UTC):
- Tue Nov 30, 10:00–12:00
- Tue Nov 30, 14:00–16:00

Let me know which works and where to upload the payloads (Drive/Dropbox).

—Alex
Alex Glover
Head of Integrations | Finch AI
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Glover <alex.glover@finchai.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: POC hands-on session & sample payloads

Alex —

Thanks, this is great. We can own the runbook on our side. Dev will lead the routing/load portion and Marissa will handle prompt/eval checks. Quick notes:

- We prefer Drive for uploads; please put files in the folder I just shared and grant edit to laura_bennett@redwood.ai and dev_patel@redwood.ai.
- Please redact PII/PHI (names, emails, SSNs). If redaction is hard, provide a small synthetic sample + a redacted real example.
- Schema expectations: CSV for tabular conversation metadata (conversation_id, timestamp, user_message, agent_message, source) and JSONL for prompt/eval sets.
- For load tests we only need a 10k request batch (split across 50 virtual clients). Well synthesize traffic if you cant provide that scale.

We can do Tue Nov 30, 14:00–16:00 UTC (preferred) — that gives us time to ingest samples Monday night. Ill drop a calendar invite once we confirm.

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Glover <alex.glover@finchai.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@finchai.com
Date: 2026-11-29T12:20:00Z
Subject: Re: POC hands-on session & sample payloads

Laura —

14:00–16:00 UTC works for us. Ill upload a redacted CSV and a JSONL with test prompts by EOD. One ask: we have a short sensitive field (customer notes) thats hard to fully redact without losing signal. Would you accept token replacements (e.g., [REDACTED_NOTE_1]) plus a mapping file kept offline?

Also, can you confirm retention for any uploaded payloads in the shared drive? Customer compliance team will want confirmation that Redwood wont persist raw PII after ingest.

Thanks — uploading now.
—Alex
From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Glover <alex.glover@finchai.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: POC hands-on session & sample payloads

Alex / Laura —

Quick technical clarifications before ingestion:

1) Token replacements are fine — please supply a short mapping file (kept offline) and mark replaced fields in the CSV columns. Well treat replacements as opaque strings during routing/LLM tests.

2) Ingestion pipeline: well run a redaction sanity check (automated) then stage files in a temp bucket for the POC engagement only. Files are deleted within 7 days after the POC unless you request otherwise. We can provide a signed statement if needed.

3) Load test plan: well run three 10-minute stages (ramp, steady, spike). Please tag prompts that must be evaluated for quality with eval:yes in the JSONL.

4) Can you include a short set (10–20) of golden prompts we can use to check regressions? That speeds up quality verification during the session.

Ill add a runbook skeleton to the Drive folder and attach a redaction checklist.

—Dev Patel
Backend Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Glover <alex.glover@finchai.com>

Team —

- finch_payloads_redacted_v1.csv (CSV, ~120KB) — names/emails replaced with [REDACTED_*] tokens and column redaction flags.
- test_prompts.jsonl (JSONL, 240 prompts; eval:yes tags on 15)
- golden_prompts.txt (10 prompts)
- mapping_offline.txt (mapping file; stored offline as discussed)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_runbook

We accepted 14:00–16:00 UTC for Nov 30. I accepted the calendar invite and added two engineers (ops@finchai.com). Please confirm you received the files and that the retention note covers deletion within 7 days.

Thanks all — look forward to tomorrow.

—Alex
